data.title: Rejection of household help (Haushaltshilfe) during spouse's rehabilitation
data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse rejects Bastian Musterquell's application for a household help (Haushaltshilfe) allowance during his wife's three-week rehabilitation, because the children are 14 and 16 (older than the 12-year limit) and he himself is not ill. The letter informs him of his right to object (Widerspruch) within one month of the decision being deemed delivered.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has turned down the request for paid household help while your wife was in rehab, saying the legal conditions under § 38 SGB V (a child under 12 in the household, or the insured person themselves unable to run the household due to illness) are not met. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree, in writing or in person at the Krankenkasse's office. The app will show you the exact deadline, calculated from when the letter is legally considered delivered. If you do nothing by then, the rejection becomes final. Consider getting advice (e.g. from a Sozialverband) if you want to challenge it.
